title: One-dimensional minimizing cones are multiplicity lines
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_1(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ) with ∂C = 0 and C a cone (IsConeCurrent C: η_{0,λ#}C = C for every λ > 0). Then there are e ∈ ℝ^P and m ∈ ℕ such that |e| = 1 whenever m > 0, spt C ⊆ ℝe = span{e}, and Θ^1(μ_C, y) = m (HasMassDensity C y m) for every y ∈ ℝe. (In fact C = m[[ℝe]] up to orientation, or C = 0 with m = 0.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → ∃ (e : Euclid P) (m : ℕ), (0 < m → ‖e‖ = 1) ∧ C.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ {e} : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {e}, HasMassDensity C y m
